	<div   class='main_color container_wrap_first container_wrap sidebar_right'  ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><main  role="main" itemprop="mainContentOfPage"  class='template-page content  av-content-small alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-668'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'><div  class='av-special-heading av-b7fnw-7c6b052673d6d43944ef343762bd8cc8 av-special-heading-h1 blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-0  el_before_av_one_full  avia-builder-el-first '><h1 class='av-special-heading-tag'  itemprop="headline"  >ACCOMMODATION</h1><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<div  class='flex_column av-76p0k-64dac4172eb8ee1e0627b29c50bcea50 av_one_full  avia-builder-el-1  el_after_av_heading  el_before_av_slideshow  first flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding  '     ><section  class='av_textblock_section av-k8yteagp-c58f5ad1d2314e4a39a58041ab0d8cdd '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p><span style="color: #0000ff;"><strong>Get special rates when booking with our Kiteboarding School in Costa Rica!!!</strong></span></p>
<p>At our Kiteboarding School in Costa Rica, we will find you a place that fit your needs. All the accommodation below are close to to the beach where the lessons take place.</p>
<p>We remind you that in case you do not have a way to get here, we do offer transfers from one of this accomodation to the beach free of charge (Except from Cañas castilla).</p>
<h1 style="text-align: center;"></h1>
<h2></h2>
<h2 style="text-align: left;"></h2>
<div id="summary">
<h2 style="text-align: left;"></h2>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Do not worry about accommodation details, our kiteboarding school takes care of it!!</strong></p>
<p>For more information do no hesitate to contatct us <a title="Contact" href="https://costakite.com/contact-costa-rica-kitesurf/">here</a>.</p>

<section  class='av_textblock_section av-k8ytfb5z-05225b90008db2f921e90f20bd812963 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="color: #31b6d6;">COSTA KITE &#8211;</span><span style="color: #31b6d6;"> NANDEL </span>Resort</h2>
<h2><img decoding="async" class="wp-image-2797 alignleft" src="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/WhatsApp-Image-2020-04-13-at-2.44.13-AM.jpeg" alt="nandel res" width="20" height="20" srcset="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/WhatsApp-Image-2020-04-13-at-2.44.13-AM.jpeg 150w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/WhatsApp-Image-2020-04-13-at-2.44.13-AM-80x80.jpeg 80w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/WhatsApp-Image-2020-04-13-at-2.44.13-AM-36x36.jpeg 36w" sizes="(max-width: 20px) 100vw, 20px" /></h2>

<p><strong>Our accommodation is located right on the beach, just pump your kite and go!!</strong></p>
<p>Surrounded by palm trees it is ideal for couples, groups of friends or solo travellers who want to stay with other riders and our school. There is a nice pool, a restaurant and all you need! Also we have very good <strong>Wi-Fi</strong> in all rooms, perfect for digital nomads!</p>
